prompt:
A real photograph taken with a good phone camera of exactly the scene laid out in the first reference picture: the same farmyard in Brandenburg on the same sunny morning in early autumn, from the same spot by the gate, in the same tall vertical framing, with the same lens. The first reference picture fixes the composition only, and the composition is kept to the last detail: every person, every animal and every object stays in the same place, at the same size and in the same pose as there. The photograph has the look of a real phone photo: the grain of weathered grey wood, straw with its individual stalks, feathers and fur with their individual hairs, wet mud and puddles that reflect the sky, rough brick and old roof tiles, worn metal, grass and small flowers, denim and cotton with their creases and weave, real human skin with its pores and small marks, hair with a few stray strands, and the uneven warm sunlight of a real morning coming from the right, with real soft shadows on the ground.

The second reference picture shows the young woman in three-quarter view, the third from the front: her face, her dark blonde hair tied back in a ponytail, her build and her height are exactly as in them. Use them for the person only; she wears here what she wears in the first picture, a red-and-black checked shirt open over a white T-shirt, blue jeans and dark-green rubber boots, and she keeps her place, her pose and her laugh.

Every surface stays plain, exactly as in the first picture: the crate, the milk pail and the sacks are plain, the apples have plain unmarked skins, and the walls, the fence and the barn are bare wood, brick and stone.

The layout to keep, as in the first picture. THE FRONT, on the packed earth of the yard: on the left the grey metal milk can, next to it the wooden crate full of red apples, below them the wicker basket of brown eggs with one egg on the ground, three brown hens pecking around the basket, puddles on the right, and the black-and-white sheepdog lying on the right with its head up. THE MIDDLE: the young woman standing in the centre, seen whole from her head to her boots, holding one red apple out on her open hand towards the brown horse that stretches its head over the wooden fence on the left, her other hand holding a second apple at her chest; the black-and-white cow in the green meadow behind the fence; the small boy in a straw hat crouching on the right and holding out grain to a hen; the pink pig in its muddy pen behind him; the farmer with a grey beard and flat cap carrying a bale of straw in the middle distance; the stone well with its little wooden roof and bucket on the right; the wooden bench against the house. THE BACK: the brick farmhouse with red tiled roof, green shutters and green door on the right; the wooden barn with its open door, ladder, stacked firewood, two pumpkins and brown sack on the left; the cat on the low stone wall; the big apple tree with red apples; the bird on the roof ridge; the green hill with white sheep, the wheat field, the dark forest and the blue sky with a few white clouds.
